basis: The YES/NO field was perfectly repeatable but said YES for 121/128 depth9 queries, including 49/53 actual current failures. It lost 22 successes versus new-prompt direct depth10 (76 vs 98), so it is not a useful stopper. Separately, the new prompt improved depth9 and depth10 answer quality on this deliberately enriched sample. A matched old-prompt rerun gives 54->75 depth9 and 81->98 depth10 0.90 successes. This possible answer-generation benefit must be tested on a fresh, unstratified train-side sample and across all attainable anchors with full Target cost.
limits: The 128 IDs were enriched for historical SF/FS/FF and cannot estimate population prevalence or deployable quality. The modified prompt changes the Target answer contract and costs roughly 141-147 extra Target tokens per call on this sample.
